title: Treaty Dev Server Target
description: Serve a Treaty application with the Rspack dev server and automatic Module Federation.

entry.description: The application entry point, relative to the workspace root (e.g. `src/main.ts`).

port.description: Port the dev server listens on.

host.description: Host interface the dev server binds to.

name.description: This app's Module Federation container/library name. Defaults to the project name.

remotes.description: Remotes this app consumes while serving, keyed by the local alias used in dynamic imports.

exposes.description: Modules this app exposes while serving, keyed by public import path.
